csv_project_name: DB For Ranger Headquaters Storage Building
csv_scope_of_work: Design and build a 30'x72' pole barn style storage building at our Five Rivers MetroParks Rangers Headquarters at 2151 Embury Park Rd., Dayton, OH 45414. The building will be divided into four sections. Each section will have a man door and/or a 12' tall garage door. One of the sections will need a mezzanine or loft for additional storage. The building will have a concrete floor, heat, water and floor drain, lighting and outlets throughout. Five Rivers MetroParks is in the process of getting a professional topographical site survey and that will be available in the design phase.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
